back.es: te = you (informal tú, direct or indirect object pronoun, placed before the conjugated verb), as in te quiero = I love you
back.example: Te llamo mañana. = I'll call you tomorrow.

note: The hint is needed: it rules out usted forms (lo, la, le) and the stressed form a ti, and the object meaning keeps this card apart from the reflexive "yourself" card.
